project.name: Roblox Lua Builder
project.description: Browser-based visual editor that builds Luau scripts from connected blocks.

current_architecture.application_type: React single-page application served by Express

external_dependencies.name: Google Fonts
external_dependencies.used_for: DM Sans and Space Grotesk in the page head

external_dependencies.name: Giphy media URL
external_dependencies.used_for: decorative canvas background declared in styles.css

site_map.purpose: Search and browse block definitions by category; drag blocks into the editor
Build the script as a tree of commands, structures and connected values
Show deterministic Luau output and copy it to the clipboard
Edit selected block properties and show contextual summaries/previews
Show validation status and up to three validation messages
Typing minigame that uses generated code or meme text as the challenge

active_editor_data_flow: Block definitions in app.js are normalized by src/core/VisualBlockDefinition.js.
The in-memory project tree is created, connected and searched through src/core/VisualBlockTree.js.
src/core/VisualConnectionSystem.js checks sequence, body and value connection compatibility.
Edits trigger validation and Luau generation in app.js; expression serialization uses src/core/LuauExpressionSerializer.js.
Saving downloads a .lua text file containing generated Luau plus a base64 JSON project marker; loading reads that marker and reconstructs the block tree.
The page does not autosave the project to browser storage or a server; the 'Autosave ativo' label is not backed by localStorage, sessionStorage or IndexedDB in the active code path.
The Run script button validates the project and displays a prompt to test it in Roblox Studio; it does not run Luau.

block_catalog.source_of_truth_for_active_ui: app.js: definitions, categories, categoryAliases, englishLabels, portugueseLabels and libraryOrder

normalized_block_contract.outputs: typed output for VALUE and EXPRESSION blocks
normalized_block_contract.bodies: named command bodies on STRUCTURE blocks

block_catalog.inventory_note: The active catalog is a private constant inside app.js and is not currently exposed to other modules or a server. MCP catalog operations need a shared exported catalog module or a maintained generated manifest; do not duplicate the entire catalog by hand.

tree_node.properties: literal property values or nested connected value-block nodes
tree_node.bodies: map of body id to arrays of command nodes

project_file.compatibility: A plain Luau file without the marker can be generated/copied, but cannot restore visual blocks.

root_files.index.html: Page markup, editor panels, controls and typing hub.
root_files.app.js: Active UI controller, legacy block catalog, tree editing, validation, code generation, import/export and typing minigame.
root_files.styles.css: Application layout, editor/block styling, themes, responsive and minigame styles.
root_files.package.json: Express start/build scripts and React runtime dependencies; Node test script.
root_files.README.md: Framework overview, setup notes and current published editor link.
root_files.memes/: Local audio assets used by the typing minigame.

src/core/.BlockRegistry.js: Reusable registry API for block configs.
src/core/.LuauExpressionSerializer.js: Format property values and serialize nested visual expressions.
src/core/.ScopeSystem.js: Variable declaration and visibility by scope.
src/core/.VisualBlockDefinition.js: Legacy-to-visual block normalization and visual type/kind definitions.
src/core/.VisualBlockTree.js: Create, find, connect, insert, detach and count tree nodes.
src/core/.VisualConnectionSystem.js: Validate command sequences, value connections and bodies.
src/core/.VisualProjectFile.js: Encode/decode project metadata and normalize loaded trees.
src/core/.VisualTypeSystem.js: Visual type compatibility and output type rules.

tests/.framework.test.js: Node test suite for core framework contracts, modular blocks/generators and selected active UI catalog/project behaviors.

currently_imported_by_app_js: appendVisualProjectMetadata, normalizeVisualProjectTree and readVisualProjectMetadata from src/core/VisualProjectFile.js
framework_boundary.note: The modular src/blocks and src/generators/luau implementations are tested framework building blocks. The active editor still generates from definitions/templates in app.js; the two catalogs/generation paths are not yet unified.

mcp_design.integration_style: Separate stateless MCP server importing shared domain modules; do not import app.js because it binds directly to browser DOM globals.

not_in_scope_without_new_runtime: Run or deploy scripts into Roblox Studio/cloud.
Read or mutate the browser editor's live state from a separate MCP process.
Persist projects remotely or authenticate users.
Execute arbitrary Luau supplied by a caller.
mcp_design.recommended_next_boundary: Extract the app.js definitions, category metadata, labels and generation/validation logic behind a DOM-free shared module; keep UI rendering in app.js and import the shared module from both browser and MCP server.

verification.current_mcp_coverage: None; no MCP package, server entrypoint, transport or tool implementation exists.
